layers.name: data layer
layers.responsibility: Read local QSB registries / fallback to HTTP if needed

layers.name: scene model layer
layers.responsibility: Normalize floors/lifts/openclaw/commerce into native scene snapshot

layers.name: scene engine layer
layers.responsibility: Render the QSB skyscraper using QGraphicsScene + QGraphicsView

layers.name: HUD layer
layers.responsibility: Sidebar with verified totals + Commerce Wing + safety locks

layers.name: safety layer
layers.responsibility: Stamp safety locks on every payload; no credentials in logs
